output.title: Cloudflare DNS01 fix: environment issuer config not visible
output.content: The release note fixes DNS01 certificate issuance on Cloudflare after a Cloudflare API breaking change. The environment summary lists only certificates.cert-manager.io [v1] and a cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate manifest. It shows no Issuer or ClusterIssuer, no CRD for them (crds dimension is absent), and no DNS01 or Cloudflare solver configuration. The operator should check whether any Issuer or ClusterIssuer uses a dns01 solver with the cloudflare provider; if so, the fix is relevant to the upgrade, otherwise it is not.
